search_log: Searched "A Fate Inked in Blood" "Danielle L. Jensen" excerpt and opened Penguin's authorized sample PDF.
Searched "A Fate Inked in Blood" "first person" and "first-person narrator"; found explicit whole-book descriptions from SuperSummary, Bookhype, and StoryGraph.

Searched "A Fate Inked in Blood" "single POV", "Freya's POV", and alternating POV; multiple completed-book reviews described a single Freya viewpoint, and no credible alternating-person structure was found.
Publisher catalog and Google Books synopsis pages verified the title and author but were not used as person evidence because synopsis grammar is nondiagnostic.
person_note: The base narration is Freya's first-person past-tense account. Numerous Goodreads event passages from varied scenes directly place her in the action as 'I,' 'me,' and 'my,' while the authorized publisher opening independently sustains the same narrating position. Whole-book descriptions further identify Freya as the sole first-person viewpoint, with no evidence of sustained sections in another person. First-person statements by Bjorn and second-person addresses to Freya are local dialogue, not competing narrators; bare third-person speech beats are nondiagnostic. The publisher excerpt is limited to the opening, but the interior quote evidence and explicit whole-book sources remove the main scope uncertainty.
